item: row 298: edited-within-a-year reference never the extract date once daily files applied undated
summary: Geography, freshness and the admin1 split took their reference as diff_timestamp or extract_vintage, so with daily files applied but their date not read they aged newer data from the extract date and the profile reported it as the reference. country_reference (from country_data_date) now gives no reference in that state; each surface says date-not-read (one new sentence x12) and computes nothing.
